plan: This is a first-price sealed-bid auction with 3 bidders and payment at the second-highest bid. Since there's no history, I'll assume a standard optimal strategy for a second-price auction. Bidding my true value is a dominant strategy in a second-price auction, as it maximizes my utility regardless of what others bid. My value is $25.

I will bid slightly above my value to maximize profit in this single round. Since I don't have historical data, I'll assume other bidders are rational and might bid close to their values. Bidding slightly above my value ensures I win if others bid their true value or less, while minimizing the risk of overpaying significantly.

The optimal strategy in a second-price auction with N bidders is to bid your true value. Since there are 3 bidders (including me), and the other bidders are rational, they will also bid their true values. My value is $9. Therefore, I will bid $9.
